issues.title: Remote startup accepted unusable media sessions

reproduction.expected: A non-live history item advances through the remote queue and falls through when the first resolver session is unusable.
reproduction.actual: The remote API reported playing after MPV created an IPC socket, while position remained at zero and the media URL returned HTTP 403.

root_cause.explanation: bkgrnd discarded yt-dlp's short available_at delay and opened the signed media URL before YouTube allowed it; the startup path then treated IPC creation as playable without requiring a real position.
root_cause.pattern: Resolver metadata required for media validity was dropped before handing a direct GVS URL to MPV.

fix.description: Honor YouTube's bounded stream-availability timestamp, require a real non-idle MPV position before startup succeeds, and fall through the resolver chain when readiness fails.

regression_provenance.baseline_claim: The prior delivery claimed reliable YouTube startup and fallback based on a single curated live verifier URL.
regression_provenance.drift_observation: A real non-live history URL was accepted as playing while its position stayed at zero; the old proof never exercised this path.
regression_provenance.suspect_change_window: Implementation and verification introduced by the 2026-08-19 youtube-playback-resilience delivery.

issues.title: Ordinary YouTube sessions had no automatic recovery

reproduction.expected: A stalled or abnormally exited ordinary video resumes through the next usable resolver.
reproduction.actual: Recovery watchers and abnormal-exit fallback were restricted to sessions marked live, so non-live playback stopped without recovery.

root_cause.explanation: The recovery watcher filtered SessionRecovery by is_live and the exit strategy repeated that restriction, excluding ordinary videos from both stall and abnormal-exit recovery.
root_cause.pattern: A reliability mechanism was scoped to one media subtype even though every resolver returns expiring or rejectable direct media URLs.

fix.description: Attach guarded stall and abnormal-exit recovery to every YouTube session while retaining pause, shuffle, clean-exit, and generation ownership protections.

regression_provenance.baseline_claim: The prior delivery claimed playback resilience but implemented automatic recovery only for live sessions.
regression_provenance.drift_observation: Ordinary remote-controlled videos could stall or exit after startup with no resolver transition.
regression_provenance.suspect_change_window: Implementation and verification introduced by the 2026-08-19 youtube-playback-resilience delivery.
